capabilities: enable a distraction-free Writing Mode via setting or ribbon icon
format chapters and indented paragraphs with hidden Markdown markers
insert dialogue, paragraphs, and chapters through typing shortcuts
keep files as standard .md documents editable without the plugin
extras: EPUB export, scene breaks, and additional customization are listed only as roadmap items, not implemented; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian's editor is geared toward note-taking, so long-form writers face formatting distractions and accidental Markdown shortcuts.
summary: Writing-focused editor mode that adds book-style typography, chapter markers, paragraph indentation, and writing shortcuts while keeping standard Markdown files.
